integrity: Hasse coefficient proof, hypergeometric identity, differential equation, Picard-height argument, and executable finite regression are contained in the package.
scientific_limitations: Smooth finite coefficient base only; no moduli quotient, singular-fibre or complete zeta classification; residual risk of an unindexed earlier equivalent calculation.
title: A squarefree quadratic root of the Dwork-quartic Hasse divisor
